notes: Modified cash basis school district (Aug 31 FYE). Governmental lines use the Totals Governmental Funds column (p7-9); beginning/ending cash = total fund balance 1,530,629 / 1,872,140 (p9), equal to cash plus cash at county treasurers. Transfers out 100,614 (General Fund 118,907 less 18,293 transfer to Activities Fund eliminated by Adjustments column); transfers in total 0 after elimination. 'Other' receipts (237,465) and 'Other Support Services' (299,601) were split using the fund columns printed on the same lines (Activities Fund holds 228,514 receipts and 251,501 disbursements; Depreciation Fund 48,100). School Nutrition is the only proprietary fund (business-type): receipts are the sum of printed lines (operating 133,504 + interest 138 = 133,642), measure = cash since cash basis (cash 43,656 equals net position). Detail: general fund budget schedule used (more detailed than the statement); fund schedules p15-17 and p19 for Depreciation, Special Building, QCPU and School Nutrition. Detail transfers: General Fund 8000 Transfers -118,907 (includes 100,614 to nutrition and 18,293 to activities); schedule totals that include transfers carry includes other financing. Budget columns are 'Original and Final'. No liabilities on the cash-basis net position statement. Re-check (attempt 2): 'Other State Receipts' 350,539 split using the fund schedules into Homestead Exemption 11,795, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 4,051 and remaining state aid 334,693; the General Fund column of 'Other' 8,951 split per p12 into tuition 600, refund 137, ESU receipts 1,546 and other 6,668. Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Fund Balances (p5-6, Totals column; totals equal the government-wide 1,872,140), fund balance by classification; business-type lines and the totals stay from the Statement of Net Position (p1). 2650 Vehicle Operation (0 actual) moved to Building and Grounds. Verifier fixes (attempt 3): Activities Fund detail now taken account by account from the per-account schedule (pp20-21: receipts 229,163, disbursements 251,501, transfers in (out) 18,293 net; accounts with all-zero activity omitted, inter-account transfers recorded signed as Transfers In/Out); the one-line Activities budget schedule (p18) lines were removed to avoid double counting. The 'Interest' account (649) is Interest Income. 'Daily Sales' 36,222 (receipt and detail 1600) recategorised School Lunch Sales. Read pages 1-21 of 21
